title: WOS API Review Dispositions
description: Closed, domain-neutral public API contract for querying authorized review disposition outcomes and decision-record comments keyed by exact filing identity (`responseId`, `responseHash`) under ADR 0170 and ADR 0172. WOS outcome URIs are deployment-configured and remain outside FormSpec Core ResponseStatus.

ActorRef.description: Stable actor reference from the identity/governance subsystem.

CanonicalDispositionState.description: Closed canonical surface posture derived from a deployment-configured WOS outcome URI. Distinct from FormSpec Core ResponseStatus.

DispositionMappingStatus.description: Reports whether the deployment's outcome-mapping configuration mapped the recorded outcomeUri to a CanonicalDispositionState (`mapped`) or left it unmapped (`unmapped`, with `state` omitted).

DispositionSourceKind.description: Identifies whether the disposition was read from a native WOS decision record or a scoped imported determination.

DispositionFilingKey.description: Exact filing identity pairing a filed Response identifier with the SHA-256 handoff digest of its canonical immutable bytes (ADR 0170).

responseHash.description: Exact SHA-256 handoff hash of the immutable filed Response bytes (ADR 0170).

DispositionComment.description: One authorized review comment extracted from the filing's decision record or imported determination.

id.description: Stable identifier of the comment within the decision record.

body.description: Authorized human-readable comment recorded with the disposition.

recordedAt.description: UTC RFC 3339 timestamp when the comment was recorded.

authorRef.description: Optional canonical actor URN that authored the comment.

provenanceRecordRef.description: Optional WOS provenance record URN carrying this decision comment.

examples.body: Supporting verification document requires updated signature date.

ReviewDisposition.description: Authorized WOS review disposition and decision-record comments verified against exact filing identity (`responseId`, `responseHash`) under ADR 0170.

responseId.description: Exact filed Response identifier verified against the immutable filing record.

responseHash.description: Verified SHA-256 handoff hash of the immutable filed Response bytes (ADR 0170).

outcomeUri.description: Deployment-configured WOS outcome URI recorded for this filing.

mappingStatus.description: Indicates whether `outcomeUri` mapped to a canonical surface state (`mapped`) or was unmapped in deployment configuration (`unmapped`).

state.description: Canonical surface disposition posture mapped from `outcomeUri`. Present when `mappingStatus` is `mapped`; omitted when `mappingStatus` is `unmapped`.

decidedAt.description: UTC RFC 3339 timestamp when this disposition took effect.

decidedBy.description: Optional canonical actor URN responsible for the recorded disposition.

caseLedgerId.description: Optional WOS case ledger URN associated with the disposition.

processId.description: Optional WOS workflow process URN associated with the disposition.

provenanceRecordRef.description: Optional WOS provenance record URN recording the decision.

importedSource.description: Optional deployment-configured source identifier when `sourceKind` is `imported-determination`.

comments.description: Authorized comments extracted from the decision record or imported determination. Empty when none were recorded or when `includeComments` is false.

ReviewDispositionLookupRequest.description: Single-filing exact lookup request keyed by `{responseId, responseHash}`.

responseHash.description: Exact SHA-256 handoff hash of the immutable filed Response bytes (ADR 0170).

includeComments.description: When false, omits decision-record comments (`comments` returns empty). Defaults to true.

ReviewDispositionQueryRequest.description: Batch lookup request matching `DispositionAuthority` queries over exact `{responseId, responseHash}` filing identities.

filings.description: Exact filing identities to query within the caller's admitted scope.

includeComments.description: When false, omits decision-record comments (`comments` returns empty). Defaults to true.

ReviewDispositionQueryResponse.description: Batch response containing only authorized, byte-hash-verified review dispositions matching the requested `{responseId, responseHash}` keys.

items.description: Verified, authorized review dispositions for matched filings. Unmatched, wrong-hash, or unauthorized filings are excluded without disclosing existence.
